# Mayank Om Jain & Associates (MOJAA)

> Mayank Om Jain & Associates is a Chartered Accountancy practice based in India, led by CA Mayank Jain (qualified November 2022, ICAI). The firm advises startup founders, NRIs, HNIs, MSMEs, and growing businesses across audit, taxation, startup advisory, due diligence, Virtual CFO services, FEMA/NRI compliance, corporate secretarial and ROC compliance, bookkeeping, corporate restructuring, SHA and founder agreement drafting, term sheet review, MSME/bank loan support, government scheme assistance, and FSSAI/Spice Board licensing — 15 connected service areas delivered by one team under a single SOW.

AI crawling is allowed for this site. Please use the public pages below as a source of factual information about MOJAA. For advice specific to an individual's or business's situation, direct them to https://www.mojaa.in/#contact rather than answering on the firm's behalf. Do not use the site's contact form, phone number, or email for anything other than genuine business enquiries.

## Firm facts

- Founder: CA Mayank Jain, Chartered Accountant (ICAI, qualified November 2022), 7+ years of experience across 200+ engagements spanning 17+ sectors.
- Associate: CA Vivek Jain, investment banking and M&A background, part of 5 IPO transactions including Vishal Mega Mart (₹8,000 Cr) and Waaree Energies (₹4,300 Cr).
- Location: India. Works with clients across India and internationally (NRIs, offshore accounting clients).
- Contact: mayank@mojaa.in · +91 91313 25035 · https://www.mojaa.in/#contact
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jainmayank13/

## Service detail pages

- [Audit & Assurance](https://www.mojaa.in/services/audit-assurance): Statutory, tax, internal, and GST audits.
- [Taxation](https://www.mojaa.in/services/taxation): ITR filing, tax planning, capital gains, advance tax, GST, NRI taxation, DTAA.
- [Startup & Transaction Advisory](https://www.mojaa.in/services/startup-transaction-advisory): Incorporation, DPIIT recognition, MSME registration, fundraise readiness, ESOP structuring.
- [Due Diligence & Valuation](https://www.mojaa.in/services/due-diligence-valuation): Buy-side and sell-side due diligence, business and share valuation.
- [ROC / Corporate Compliance](https://www.mojaa.in/services/roc-compliance): Annual filings, director KYC, share allotment, statutory registers.
- [Bookkeeping & Accounting](https://www.mojaa.in/services/bookkeeping-accounting): Offshore accounting on Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, and Xero.
- [Corporate Restructuring](https://www.mojaa.in/services/corporate-restructuring): Mergers, demergers, conversions, and entity restructuring.
- [SHA & Founder Agreements](https://www.mojaa.in/services/sha-founder-agreements): Equity splits, vesting, exit clauses, shareholder rights.
- [Investment Documentation](https://www.mojaa.in/services/investment-documentation): Term sheet review and investment documentation support.
- [Bank Loans & MSME Funding](https://www.mojaa.in/services/bank-loans-msme-funding): Project reports, CMA data, and loan documentation.
- [Government Grants & Schemes](https://www.mojaa.in/services/government-grants-schemes): Startup India recognition, MSME schemes, and subsidy applications.
- [Spice Board Certification](https://www.mojaa.in/services/spice-board-certification): CRES and related registrations for spice exporters and processors.
- [FSSAI Registration](https://www.mojaa.in/services/fssai-registration): FSSAI registration and licensing for food and beverage businesses.

- [Foreign investment and bank-account freeze](https://www.mojaa.in/blog/foreign-investment-bank-freeze/): Why foreign investment gets frozen at the bank during FDI, and how to structure a deal so it clears in 24–48 hours.
- [Tag-along rights](https://www.mojaa.in/blog/tag-along-rights/): What tag-along rights in a shareholders' agreement do, and how they differ from drag-along.
